entities.name: Ribokinase
observations: The 309-aa query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed E. coli ribokinase references P0A9J7 and P0A9J6.
Curated function: phosphorylates ribose at O-5 using ATP and a divalent metal ion.
Annotated as cytosolic and homodimeric; EC 2.7.1.15.
Sequence analysis identifies Pfam PfkB (PF00294) at residues 6-297 and Phos_pyr_kin (PF08543) at residues 165-287.

entities.name: D-ribose phosphorylation
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:13697 and EC 2.7.1.15.

entities.name: Magnesium ion
observations: Mg(2+) is the primary physiological divalent cation cofactor supporting phosphoryl-group transfer; Mn(2+) can also support activity in the E. coli reference annotation.

entities.name: D-ribose degradation
observations: Ribokinase produces D-ribose 5-phosphate, which feeds nucleotide, histidine, tryptophan, and pentose-phosphate metabolism.
